mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp UNRATE spike, or the unemployment rate explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will pressure corporate margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 3-month periods following a 2% INDPRO drop, or INDPRO explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts signals a strong residential investment cycle that boosts economic activity and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following rising housing starts, or HOUST explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases borrowing costs and pressures corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 6-month periods following a 1% FEDFUNDS hike, or FEDFUNDS explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of 3-month periods following a 2% RSAFS drop, or RSAFS explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following rising PAYEMS, or PAYEMS explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation signals rising input costs that will pressure corporate margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of 3-month periods following a 1% CPI spike, or CPIAUCSL explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.
